svg.title: What each part of the lifecycle policy over make-room does
svg.desc: The voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale against the SLO of 2.02 s, beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, of the lifecycle policy over make-room with all its parts, 2.06 s at the median of 5 runs (1.98 to 2.13 s), and with one part removed or changed, the median of three runs and their range: in its gateway policy, without the critical-window throttle 2.05 s (1.99 to 2.08 s), without the headroom 2.03 s (1.95 to 2.07 s), the headroom armed by the request 2.12 s (2.01 to 2.17 s), the throttle's budget at 0 ms 2.11 s (2.09 to 2.17 s), the throttle's budget at 500 ms 2.06 s (1.99 to 2.08 s), without the lifecycle events 2.04 s (2.01 to 2.05 s), without degrade 3.84 s (2.89 to 4.08 s), without degrade, with a 48-token window 2.20 s (2.10 to 2.29 s), without the gateway policy 4.03 s (2.98 to 4.06 s); in the engine under it, without the KV preemption 2.04 s (1.99 to 2.04 s), without the reserve 2.12 s (2.12 to 2.15 s), without the budget cap 5.29 s (5.06 to 6.11 s), without the change 10.99 s (10.03 to 11.96 s).
svg.text: The headroom armed by the request
